$description: Structured copy of the iOS answers on DREAMT-4718 (2026-11-18) that scripts read. Source data: do not edit. Wording and full answer: 2026-11-18-DREAMT-4718-ios.md in this folder.
source: Ameer Moukadam, DREAMT-4718 comment 276648, 2026-11-18; TroncKit @ f79fe3339; MNG iOS Style Guide v21 (artifact version 1795029427-a74c)

rules: Same in every market and the same as Android.
When the view is too narrow for the ad, it falls back to 320 × 50.
ad_slots.adhesion_note: iOS has no adhesion (sticky) banner. The adhesionBannerBackgroundColor theme color exists but no banner uses it.

checkbox.image_placement: centered at natural size (17 × 18 pt) inside the 30 × 30 pt button

onboarding_fallback: Markets without their own onboarding art show the shared mng-top-image-view image.
dark_mode: All 77 apps are light mode only; nothing in the code is moving toward dark mode.
per_market_icon_copies: Each recolored set (Saved-*, Checkmark-*, Uncheck-*, YourNews-*, Continue-*, TopicSelection-*) is one glyph saved as separate PNGs; one template image tinted per market can replace it.
